parameters.convention: X=J2/sqrt(w), W=W1/sqrt(C*lambda), w=C^2[4lambda+16lambda^2 q/(1+q)], C=Js^2/lambda, q=exp(-4lambda), beta=mu=0, hbar=1/string time, DS first. F=trace[X(t) W X(t) W], D=2(1-F). Distinct species, one crossed channel; mutual q^2 retained.

scope: Existing BINT unequal-probe positive series with d1=2,d2=1 and mutual q^2, applied after the stage three-species identification. Independent colored-chord Taylor enumeration checks the time expansion. Analytic bounds cover infinite-Jacobi truncation in exact arithmetic; refinement, species exchange and roundoff-sensitive relative errors are numerical checks, not interval certification. Only actual low-coefficient A0/B1 fields are interpreted here, not the complete finite-relative-time bilocal four-point function, a vacuum CCR algebra or a bulk scattering amplitude.
